definition: Adam Tauman Kalai is an American computer scientist who specializes in artificial intelligence.
details: He was a researcher at OpenAI from 2023 to 2026 and is a cofounder of the Institute for Responsible Superintelligence (RESI).
story: Picture a potter shaping clay on a spinning wheel: every nudge is tiny, but each one is guided by how the last attempt wobbled. Underneath all the magic is a patient process of small improvements. The machine starts out clumsy, makes mistakes, and is nudged a little less wrong every time. Each pass is a tiny course-correction — the model gets a little less wrong every time. That steady, miss-by-miss improvement is Adam Tauman Kalai.
